name: Jehoiada (son of Paseah)
title: Repaired the Old Gate
summary: Jehoiada, son of Paseah, along with Meshullam, repaired the Old Gate in Jerusalem during the rebuilding of the wall in Nehemiah's time.

keyEvents.title: Repairing the Old Gate
keyEvents.description: Jehoiada, son of Paseah, restored the Old Gate together with Meshullam.
